ground_truth_kind: Human object annotations; action references are derived from explicit policies, not human-labeled actions.
filter: iscrowd == 0; all retained annotations treated as confirmed, no detector-score threshold applied
review_policy: Take Action iff a confirmed traffic light, stop sign, knife or scissors is annotated.
robot_policy: Take Action iff annotated people, vehicles, signals, animals or tools are present, or total annotated object count >= 10. Primary plan follows documented priority.
uncertainty_rule: No uncertainty rule can be triggered by confirmed annotations. Predicted YOLO boxes between 0.25 and 0.5 can trigger verification and hence disagree with these references.
